problem: A hidden/off-viewport cursor produced null keyboard focus and reset panning to zero; restoring the cursor moved the entire pane again.
fix: Remember the last valid keyboard focus per pane, keep its viewport position through hidden-cursor frames, and avoid following a cursor while reading scrollback.

validation.device: Samsung S22+ with Gboard; isolated test app
checks: eight repeated live/hidden/history frame transitions leave the actual Android view Y position unchanged
grid dimensions remain unchanged while scrolling
real Gboard opening/closing keeps the grid stable
top prompts remain stationary and bottom prompt footers remain visible
new live frames are not replaced by stale Compose frames

native_redraw.fix: Honor libghostty synchronized output holds rather than publishing intermediate clear/partial frames; retain the previous complete frame.
tests: real actor plus loopback protocol peers keep the same complete frame during delayed clear/partial redraw, then publish the completed redraw
a stuck hold expires after one second
a new hold resets the timer even when end/start share one input chunk
